dates.name: Shakespeare's "Macbeth" — Feline Theater Production
dates.desc: A creative reimagining of Shakespeare's Macbeth with a playful feline twist. Part of Park City's community theater scene with vibrant performances. Runs May 1-3; perfect for an evening in the mountains.

dates.name: Sundance Mountain Resort — Spring Horseback Ride & Hiking Adventure
dates.desc: Sundance's spring activities open May 1-3 with guided horseback rides through aspen groves and wildflower trails, or challenging hikes to waterfalls and scenic vistas. The Foundry Grill offers Sunday brunch buffet (9 AM-2 PM). Perfect mountain retreat weekend.
dates.where: Sundance Mountain Resort — 8841 Alpine Loop Rd, Sundance, UT 84604

dates.name: Pablo Cruise — Retro Rock Concert in Park City
dates.desc: Legendary soft rock band with three original members performing their hits from the '70s and '80s. Intimate Park City venue with excellent acoustics. May 7-9 run; Friday night is the prime show.
dates.where: Park City Venues (Check visitparkcity.com for location)

dates.name: Utah Mammoth — First Round Playoff Game
dates.desc: The Utah Mammoth clinched their first-ever playoff berth in franchise history! First-round games begin around mid-April and continue through May. Check the official schedule closer to the date — this is hockey history in Salt Lake City. The atmosphere will be electric.
dates.where: Delta Center — 301 S Temple, Salt Lake City, UT 84101

dates.name: Donut Falls Hike — Big Cottonwood Canyon
dates.desc: Easy 3.3-mile hike to Utah's most unique waterfall — a stunning 607-foot cascade flowing through a perfect donut-shaped rock formation. May is ideal with spring water flow at its peak. The upper parking area opens in late April/early May as snow melts. An iconic Utah hike.
dates.where: Donut Falls Trailhead — Big Cottonwood Canyon, UT (~26 miles from SLC)

dates.name: Goblin Valley State Park — Otherworldly Landscape & Wildflowers
dates.desc: One of Utah's most unique parks: eerie red rock hoodoos ('goblins') mixed with spring wildflowers blooming across the desert. Less crowded than Arches/Canyonlands. 1 hour 45 min from Salt Lake City through stunning canyon scenery. Hike the loops, photograph the alien landscape, and pack a picnic.
dates.where: Goblin Valley State Park — Hanksville, UT (100 miles SE of SLC, near Green River)

dates.name: Bells Canyon Trail — Multiple Waterfall Options
dates.desc: Flexible hike with multiple waterfall payoffs: 1 mile round trip to Bell Canyon Lake, 4.5 miles to Lower Falls, or 10 miles to Upper Falls & Lake. Pick your adventure based on energy level. May water flow is excellent, and the canyon is less crowded than Big Cottonwood. Great for exploration.
dates.where: Bells Canyon Trailhead — Sandy, UT (south of Little Cottonwood Canyon, ~40 min from SLC)

dates.name: Dinner at Handle — Park City
dates.desc: One of Park City's most celebrated restaurants — creative American small plates and hearty entrees in a restored historic building on Heber Ave. Arrive early to stroll Historic Main Street before dinner; the whole area is walkable and buzzing with spring energy.
dates.where: Handle — 136 Heber Ave, Park City, UT 84060

dates.name: Park City Historic Main Street — Explore & Dine
dates.desc: Walkable historic district lined with local restaurants, galleries, and shops. Grab coffee at a local café, browse art galleries, and choose from diverse dining options (pizza, sushi, burgers, fine dining). Live music often plays on weekends. Perfect for a relaxed spring afternoon.
dates.where: Park City Historic Main Street — Park City, UT (various restaurants/galleries)

dates.name: Mirror Lake Scenic Byway — High Alpine Drive & Hiking
dates.desc: Utah's highest paved road at 10,715 feet (Bald Mountain Pass). 42-mile scenic drive with multiple pullouts, photo ops, and short hikes. Opens late May typically. Stunning panoramic views, mountain wildflowers, and pristine alpine lakes. Bring layers — it's cool at elevation.
dates.where: Mirror Lake Scenic Byway — State Route 150, Kamas to Duck Creek (1 hour from Park City)

dates.name: TopGolf at Vineyard — Gamified Golf Experience
dates.desc: Gamified golf bays with automatic scoring, full food menu, and zero golf skill required. Fun step up from mini golf with impressive venue, lively bar scene, and competitive energy. Bay pricing is per bay, not per person — great value for two.
dates.where: TopGolf — 484 N Entertainment Way, Vineyard, UT 84059

dates.name: Riverdance — The Show at Eccles Theater
dates.desc: The legendary Irish dance and music spectacular — thunderous footsteps, live orchestral score, and mesmerizing choreography. Runs May 22-24 (slightly outside current window, but reserve now!). One of the most beloved touring shows. You loved The Phantom; this is equally spectacular.
dates.where: Eccles Theater — 131 S Main St, Salt Lake City, UT 84101

dates.name: Clark Planetarium + The Gateway District Stroll
dates.desc: Free interactive science museum with immersive space exhibits and digital full-dome IMAX theater. Then stroll The Gateway district outside for dessert, shopping, or an arcade bar. Easy afternoon with lots of options.
dates.where: Clark Planetarium — 110 S 400 W, Salt Lake City, UT 84101

dates.name: Themed Cook-Off Challenge at Home
dates.desc: Pick a cuisine neither of you has cooked before — Japanese, Moroccan, Thai, Korean, Vietnamese, Lebanese — grab ingredients together, then challenge yourselves to make a full meal from scratch. Set timers, taste-test, laugh at mistakes, and enjoy the result. Competitive and creative.

dates.name: Board Game Tournament Night at Home
dates.price: Free (if you own games) or $0 - $20 (new game purchase)
dates.desc: Pick 2-3 board games you've never played together. Set a tournament bracket, keep score across games, and crown an ultimate champion. Grab snacks, make it competitive, and celebrate victory. Silly, fun, and surprisingly engaging.

dates.name: Escape Room at Getout Games — Salt Lake City
dates.desc: Four themed rooms downtown: Egyptian Tomb, Zombie on a Chain, The Heist, or Reactor Room. 60 minutes of puzzle-solving and teamwork under pressure. Book in advance; evening slots available daily. Great for testing your problem-solving chemistry.
dates.where: Getout Games — 202 W 400 S, Salt Lake City, UT 84101

dates.name: Indoor Rock Climbing at Red Rock Climbing Center
dates.desc: Beginner-friendly climbing gym in Salt Lake with hundreds of routes at all difficulty levels. No experience needed — staff teaches you everything. It's active, fun, slightly competitive, and feels like a real achievement (even on easy walls). Great date energy.
dates.where: Red Rock Climbing Center — 2074 E Fort Union Blvd, Salt Lake City, UT 84121
